info.title: JobMate API
info.description: Intelligence de recrutement conversationnelle — MVP. Company/Role understanding → Candidate understanding → Evidence → Assessment → Matching → Top 3 → Confrontation → Recommendation.

get.description: Who am I, and where should the app send me next (role choice, onboarding, home).

post.description: Role choice page. A role can be set once; changing it later is not allowed in the MVP.

schema.title: Response Get Company Identity Companies  Company Id  Identity Get
Response Company Identity History Companies  Company Id  Identity History Get
Response List Roles Companies  Company Id  Roles Get
Response Get Role Identity Roles  Role Id  Identity Get
Response Get Success Model Roles  Role Id  Success Model Get

patch.description: Employer corrections to the model (e.g. changing the decision priority).

post.description: A candidate creates their own profile; an employer may add a candidate they sourced.

schema.title: Response Get Identity Candidates  Candidate Id  Professional Identity Get

post.description: Candidate understanding: derive capabilities + evidence from experiences / CV.

schema.title: Response Analyze Candidate Candidates  Candidate Id  Analyze Post
Response List Evidence Candidates  Candidate Id  Evidence Get

get.description: What is known / what remains uncertain about this candidate for this role.

schema.title: Response My Opportunities Candidates Me Opportunities Get

post.description: Adaptive: picks the question that most reduces the uncertainty that matters for the decision.

schema.title: Response List Assessments Roles  Role Id  Candidates  Candidate Id  Assessments Get
Response My Assessments Candidates Me Assessments Get

post.description: The candidate answers (or, for the demo, the employer records the answer).

schema.title: Response Run Matching Roles  Role Id  Matches Run Post
Response List Matches Roles  Role Id  Matches Get
Response Get Shortlist Roles  Role Id  Shortlist Get
Response List Confrontations Roles  Role Id  Confrontations Get

CandidateAnalysisOut.description: Known vs uncertain, for one candidate against one role's Success Model.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: capability keys that must ALL hold for this path

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: relative value of succeeding via this path (e.g. <1 when it implies ramp-up)

updates.title: Updates
